text.description_html:
Acorn RUFBI, Heart Tip Forged Rim Latches Sets For Exterior And Interior Doors

This Iron Rim Latch Set for Exterior And Interior Doors comes with a heart tip handle for both the exterior and the interior and an easy flip down locking device for privacy. It is made from iron so that it will be sure to add an authentic old world touch to any lightweight door. Made by Acorn, it has a rough black iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of natural weathered iron.

Specifications: of the Heart Tip Forged Iron Rim Latch Set:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 9-1/4"
  • Handle Width: 2-5/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
